mathematics: Independent numerical and inverse-branch oracles check unit-circle values, reciprocal zero denominators, principal inverse ranges, exact arc/area/speed quantities, signed wave periods and samples, quadrant identities, addition and double-angle values, and complete periodic roots. instruction: The first lesson preserves the complete reviewed MTH 215 b06 source through a version-checked adapter. Three new lessons add original explanations and examples for signed circle coordinates, all six ratios, circular quantities, sinusoidal and time models, inverse values, identities, and full equation solutions. Four independent checkpoint questions per lesson cover each stated objective; the circular-quantity checkpoint explicitly combines arc, area, angular speed, and tangential speed.
accessibility: No Axe WCAG 2 A/AA or WCAG 2.1 AA violations, horizontal overflow, or KaTeX errors on the overview and all four lessons at desktop and 390x844 mobile sizes. All guided questions and four investigations work by keyboard. New diagrams have descriptive accessible names and equivalent text or exact tables. Tested wrong predictions, empty input, undefined ratios, signed multipliers, endpoint changes, empty solution sets, and invalid expressions. Desktop overview and mobile circle/wave screenshots inspected.
sources: Ten precise free OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e sections are recorded in resources.json, with the full verified 9.1 URL. Explanations and exercises are original. Later MTH 215 trigonometry modules are correctly described as planned.
